judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong WebSocket frame and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the explicitly specified `list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, and `ConversationCursor`. In `src/types/messages.ts`, the candidate modified existing lines rather than making purely additive changes at the end of the file, violating the first acceptance criterion. It also failed to update `MongoSessionStore` to throw `StoreCannotList`, missed the startup warning when `history` is enabled without `resume`, and leaked extra fields via `{...summary}` instead of picking only the four summary fields. Finally, the candidate omitted all required updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and several acceptance test scenarios (such as non-blocking during a streaming turn and end-to-end resume).
